species.name: Crappie
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: White bass
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 12–20 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.

South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
